description: Flashcards is an open-source spaced-repetition flashcards app with web, iOS, and Android clients plus a self-hosted deployment path. It stores study data in workspaces and supports AI-agent access for reading and modifying cards, decks, media, and package data.
summary: flashcards-open-source-app.com exposes two developer surfaces on its subdomains: a REST external AI-agent API on `api.flashcards-open-source-app.com` and a remote MCP server on `mcp.flashcards-open-source-app.com`; the REST API uses a long-lived agent API key from email OTP bootstrap, while the MCP server supports either OAuth 2.1 with DCR/PKCE or the same key as a Bearer token. It also publishes unauthenticated public snapshot/catalog read endpoints under the same API host.
